title: D-ADD: An Effective Plug-In for Defending Against Model Stealing
abstract: arXiv:2503.12497v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Malicious users attempt to replicate commercial models functionally at low cost by training a clone model with query responses. Timely prevention of such model-stealing attacks is challenging, as it requires achieving robust protection, maintaining utility, and ensuring low deployment overhead at the same time. In this paper, we propose a novel non-parametric detector called Account-aware Distribution Discrepancy (ADD) to recognize queries from malicious users by leveraging account-wise local query dependency. We formulate each class as a Multivariate Normal distribution (MVN) in the feature space and measure the malicious score as the sum of weighted class-wise distribution discrepancy. Together with shift adjustment, the ADD$^+$ detector is enhanced with the capability to manage domain shifts. When integrated with random-based prediction poisoning, it serves as a practical plug-and-play defense module, termed D-ADD, for image

translated_title: D-ADD：一种用于防御模型窃取的有效插件
translated_abstract: 恶意用户试图通过使用查询响应训练克隆模型，以低成本方式从功能上复制商业模型。及时阻止此类模型窃取攻击极具挑战性，因为这需要同时实现稳健的保护、维持模型效用并确保低部署开销。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为账户感知分布差异（Account-aware Distribution Discrepancy, ADD）的新型非参数检测器，通过利用账户级别的局部查询依赖性来识别来自恶意用户的查询。我们将每个类别表述为特征空间中的多元正态分布（MVN），并将恶意分数衡量为加权后的类别分布差异之和。结合偏移调整技术，ADD$^+$ 检测器被增强为具备管理域偏移的能力。当与基于随机的预测投毒方法集成时，它构成了一个实用的即插即用防御模块，称为 D-ADD，用于图像（分类任务中防御模型窃取攻击）。
tldr: 本文提出账户感知分布差异（ADD）检测器，利用账户级别的局部查询依赖性识别恶意查询，并与随机预测投毒相结合，形成即插即用的 D-ADD 防御模块，有效防御针对商业图像分类模型的窃取攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Account-aware Distribution Discrepancy (ADD) detector that identifies malicious queries by leveraging account-wise local query dependency, and combines it with random-based prediction poisoning to form D-ADD, a practical plug-and-play defense module against model stealing attacks on commercial image classification models.
